title: Gold and Silver Prices Reach New Highs
summary: The gold price in India has reached a new high of Rs 1.53 lakh per 10 grams, with silver also seeing a significant increase. The prices were last seen at this level seven weeks ago. The MCX index has reached ₹1,49,345 for gold and ₹2,100 for silver.
summary_points: The gold price in India has reached Rs 1.53 lakh per 10 grams.
This is the highest price in seven weeks.
Silver prices have also seen a significant increase of Rs 2,100.
The MCX index has reached ₹1,49,345 for gold and ₹2,100 for silver.
title_hi: सोना और चांदी के दाम सात हफ्ते के सबसे ऊंचे स्तर पर पहुंच गए
summary_hi: भारत में सोने की कीमतें रुपये 1.53 लाख प्रति 10 ग्राम तक पहुंच गईं, चांदी भी महत्वपूर्ण वृद्धि देखी। यह स्तर सात हफ्तों बाद पहली बार देखा गया। एमसीएक्स इंडेक्स ने ₹1,49,345 रुपये के लिए सोना और ₹2,100 रुपये के लिए चांदी पहुंचाया।

center: Largely reported the events without a distinct frame.
Outlets have focused on the recent price hike and its impact on consumers.

न्यूज़ चैनलों ने इस मामले पर विशिष्ट फ्रेम नहीं बनाया है।
